topic: Write about a Family Memory(写一段家庭回忆)
genre: 记叙文 / 个人回忆(narrate a special family memory)
source: 外研社必修第一册 Unit 3 Developing ideas: Writing about a family memory(记叙一段难忘的家庭回忆,注意时态:回忆用过去时、点题用现在/将来)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华。请用英语写一篇约80词的短文,记叙一段难忘的家庭回忆,内容包括:① 是什么勾起了这段回忆(时间/人物/地点);② 当时发生了什么事;③ 为什么这段回忆对你特别或难忘。注意:回忆部分用过去时态(一般过去/过去进行/过去完成),恰当使用时间标志词。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Write a short passage (about 80 words) about a family memory you treasure, including: 1) what brought the memory back (when / who / where); 2) what happened at that time; 3) why the memory is special or unforgettable to you. Note: use past tenses for the memory itself and link it to the present at the end.
points: 什么勾起回忆(While I was …, I found … and a memory came back)
当时发生了什么(过去时叙事:I had decided … / Mum was …)
为什么难忘(I learnt that … / It is special because …)
时态准确:回忆用过去时,点题句用现在/将来
model_essay: While I was tidying my room last weekend, I found an old photo and a lovely memory came back to me. It was my mother's birthday ten years ago, and I had decided to surprise her with home-made eggs. I woke up early and tiptoed to the kitchen, but somehow the eggs got burnt. Just as I was about to throw them away, Mum walked in, tasted them and smiled. We laughed and ate them all. That day taught me that love is indeed a magical ingredient, and I still treasure it today.
model_translation: 上周末我整理房间时,发现一张旧照片,一段美好的回忆涌上心头。那是十年前妈妈的生日,我决定亲手做鸡蛋给她惊喜。我起得很早,蹑手蹑脚溜进厨房,可鸡蛋不知怎么烧糊了。正当我要把它们扔掉时,妈妈走了进来,尝了尝,笑了。我们大笑着把蛋全吃光了。那一天让我明白爱确实是一种神奇的成分,至今我仍珍藏着这段回忆。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:勾起回忆 / 当时发生的事 / 为什么难忘
按时间顺序叙事、首尾呼应、过渡自然、点题清楚
时态准确(过去时叙事+现在/将来点题)、词汇句型多样、基本无语法错误

required_structure: 勾起回忆 While I was …, I found … and a memory came back to me.
背景 It was … ten years ago, and I had decided to …
经过 Just as I was about to …, Mum walked in …
点题 That day taught me that … , and I still treasure it today.
key_expressions: a lovely memory came back to me
I had decided to surprise her with …
Just as I was about to …, Mum walked in.
Love is indeed a magical ingredient.

high_sentences: While I was tidying my room, a lovely memory came back to me.
It was my mother's birthday ten years ago, and I had decided to surprise her.
Just as I was about to throw the eggs away, Mum walked in and smiled.
That day taught me that love is indeed a magical ingredient.

error_pairs.wrong: Yesterday I have found an old photo.
error_pairs.correct: Yesterday I found an old photo.
error_pairs.note: yesterday 是确定过去时间,用一般过去时,不用现在完成时。

error_pairs.wrong: While I tidied my room, I found a photo.
error_pairs.correct: While I was tidying my room, I found a photo.
error_pairs.note: while 引导的背景动作正在进行,用过去进行时。

error_pairs.wrong: I decided to surprise her before she woke up, so I cooked already.
error_pairs.correct: I had decided to surprise her before she woke up.
error_pairs.note: 早于过去某动作发生,用过去完成时。
